decisions.reason: Persistent help text after a field is emptied does not alter the requirement that existing placeholder text clear when the field is activated; the behaviors can coexist.
The source changes help-text persistence, not the editable-field mechanism, intended use, or handling of legacy controls.
Field help-text persistence is unrelated to table stability and page-margin behavior during legacy copy-paste.
The source does not change graphic bullet size, alignment, color, scaling, or visual design.
The decision about help text in emptied interactive fields does not change legacy-to-new template copy-paste behavior.
The source does not address manual line breaks or paragraph behavior after pasted content.
The source specifies runtime help-text persistence for fields but does not change the required style source, style-set coverage, or listed style additions.
The source does not change any theme-color requirement; the match arises only from historical references to interactive-field labels.
Help-text persistence in interactive fields does not affect Tab-controlled list levels or hierarchy alignment.
The source product decision does not change the task-local assessment method, coverage, time budget, or required report outputs.
The source does not modify heading emphasis, title size, or any other typography setting.
The updated-package obligation remains valid unchanged; the source adds a field behavior but does not modify the package requirement itself.
